hero.source:
-- Checkpoints: touch a pad to save your place, and earn coins for every new one.
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local pads = workspace:WaitForChild("Checkpoints")

local function onTouched(pad, hit)
	local character = hit.Parent
	local humanoid = character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(character)
	local stage = pad:GetAttribute("Stage")
	if player and stage > player:GetAttribute("Stage") then
		player:SetAttribute("Stage", stage)
		player.leaderstats.Coins.Value += 10
		player.RespawnLocation = pad
	end
end

local function watch(pad)
	pad.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		onTouched(pad, hit)
	end)
end

local count = 0
for _, pad in pads:GetChildren() do
	if not pad:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
		continue
	end
	watch(pad)
	count += 1
	if count >= 64 then
		break
	end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player:SetAttribute("Stage", 0)
	local leaderstats = Instance.new("Folder", player)
	leaderstats.Name = "leaderstats"
	local coins = Instance.new("IntValue", leaderstats)
	coins.Name = "Coins"
end)

	local parent = otherPart.Parent
	local humanoid = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

	if not humanoid or humanoid.Health <= 0 then
		return
	end

	local playerFromCharacter = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(parent)

	if playerFromCharacter and playerFromCharacter:GetAttribute("Stage") < stage then
		playerFromCharacter:SetAttribute("Stage", stage)

scale.what: Every script with bytecode in four real Roblox games, decompiled by V2.6 with decompile-folder on every core. Wall time per game is the median of the runs, measured around the whole process.

fuzz.what: Typed random Luau programs compiled at -O0, -O1 and -O2, decompiled by V2.6, compiled again and run beside their own bytecode on the same VM. failed = a wrong output.
